0022600100.text: The Pelicans, who are 0-1 and 9th in the West after one game, visit the Utah Jazz, who are also 0-1 after one game and 12th in the West. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot) and Trey Alexander (out, knee), and Tony Bradley is day-to-day with a quadriceps injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but New Orleans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 156-137 regular-season win in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
